hints.title: Start at the end
hints.body: The least significant digit is the rightmost one.

hints.title: Carry stops early
hints.body: If a digit is less than `9`, increase it and the increment is finished.

hints.title: All nines
hints.body: Turn every trailing `9` into `0`. If every digit was `9`, prepend a new `1`.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
result = copy of digits
for i from length(result) - 1 down to 0:
    if result[i] < 9:
        result[i] += 1
        return result
    result[i] = 0
return [1] followed by result
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
